course_name_original: Evaluation et prévention des risques socio-professionnels
course_name_en: Evaluation and prevention of socio-professional risks

learning_outcomes.text: Identify the human, social, economic and legal issues involved in OH&S within the company.
Integrate OH&S into the management of their activities and projects.
Contribute to OH&S management.
Know the definition of occupational accidents and illnesses.
Understand the rights and obligations of employees and employers in terms of hygiene, health and safety.
Identify the main OH&S players inside and outside the company, and their missions.
Distinguish between the main hazardous situations in a sector of activity (in terms of hazards, risks and damage).
Distinguish their consequences on physical and mental health.
Analyze to determine the elements of a hazardous situation.
Evaluate these risks, taking into account work organization and conditions of exposure to hazards.
Evaluate the consequences of hazardous situations on physical and mental health.
Understand the hierarchy of general prevention principles.
Apply these general principles to a hazardous or accidental situation.
Be a driving force behind workplace health and safety policies.
Adopt managerial practices and attitudes that respect employees' physical and mental health.
Implement and evaluate action programs, highlighting best practices.
Integrate health and safety aspects into the organization's overall strategy.
Linking health and safety aspects to overall performance.
Take into account the opinions of the various stakeholders when developing preventive actions.
Identify the potential impact of changes on occupational health.
Link employee skills to improvements in their work situation.
Know the financial indicators linked to occupational health: pricing, compensation, direct and indirect costs.
Know and analyze occupational injury and illness statistics by sector of activity.
Compare occupational health indicators for a given company with those for its sector of activity.

Identify the various formal and informal sources of information available within the company (Document Unique, social balance sheet, employer's account, minutes of meetings of the works council, CHSCT, CE, etc.).
Identify the hierarchy of legal sources and normative texts.
Understand the mechanisms of civil and criminal liability in the context of a professional activity.
Adopt a multidisciplinary approach to work situations in conjunction with these players.
Share the skills of these players in a multidisciplinary approach applied to a work situation.
Describe the components of a work situation.
Lead multi-disciplinary groups and get participants involved in occupational health and safety issues.

syllabus_topics: Analytical method for solving S&ST problems
A scientific, technical and technological look at prevention barriers
Managing and being managed in S&ST to reduce psycho-social risks
Human and organizational factors in S&ST performance
Doing the right thing for employees and colleagues to improve S&ST
teaching_methods: Situational exercises in pairs, trios and teams
Skills testing through quizzes or group activities
assessment_rules: Evaluation is based on individual exercises and sub-group exercises conducted throughout the tutorials.
bibliography: INRS (Institut National de Recherche en Sécurité)
ICSI (Institut pour une Culture de Sécurité Industrielle)
ANACT (Agence Nationale pour l’Amélioration des Conditions de Travail)
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
